description: Defines the HttpContext class which manages HTTP connections, event handling, routing, and socket lifecycle for the uWebSockets library, including SSL support and integration with libusockets.

classes.name: HttpContext
classes.description: Manages HTTP server context, including connection handling, routing, and socket lifecycle, supporting SSL and event-driven architecture.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new HttpContext instance with specified event loop and options.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Destroys the HttpContext and releases resources.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Adds a filter handler to process all incoming requests.

methods.name: onHttp
methods.description: Registers an HTTP route handler for a specific method and pattern.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts listening on a specified port or Unix socket.

methods.name: onPreOpen
methods.description: Sets a handler to be called before socket connection is opened.

methods.name: adoptAcceptedSocket
methods.description: Adopts an externally accepted socket into this HttpContext.
